# Data manipulation

```{r}
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% select(-q_value_pop2) # remove, and then decide if we need to 1-pop or now 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC2HYB") ~ "BC1HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC3HYB") ~ "BC2HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC4HYB") ~ "BC3HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC5HYB") ~ "BC4HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC6HYB") ~ "BC5HYB"
    )
  )

# JC_orientation means pop1 == JC? -- doesn't necessary align with the BC2POP1 labels
data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_orientation = mean(
      q_value_pop1[hybrid_status == "JC"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0.5,
    
    JC = if_else(
      JC_orientation,
      q_value_pop1,
      1 - q_value_pop1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Data validation
```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )
```


# Computing threshold acc, eff, pref
```{r}
BC_JCs <- data %>% filter(hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "BC1HYB", "BC2HYB", "BC3HYB", "BC4HYB", "BC5HYB", "BC6HYB"))

# 1. Define the sequence of thresholds from 0.85 to 0.99 by 0.01
bottom_threshold <- 0.70
top_threshold <- 1.0
thresholds <- seq(bottom_threshold, top_threshold, by = 0.001)

# 2. Get all unique hybrid classes present in your dataset
hybrid_classes <- unique(BC_JCs$hybrid_status)

# 3. Create a grid combining data, thresholds, and target hybrid classes
# This allows us to evaluate performance for each hybrid type independently (One-vs-All)
multi_class_matrices <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    BC_JCs, 
    threshold = thresholds,
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Classification rule: >= threshold is called "pure", < threshold is called the target hybrid
    predicted_class = if_else(JC >= threshold, "pure", "hybrid"),
    
    # Check if the row's true hybrid status matches the current target class being evaluated
    true_class = if_else(hybrid_status == "JC", "pure", "hybrid")
  ) %>% group_by(hybrid_status, threshold) %>%
  summarize(
    TP = sum(predicted_class == "hybrid" & true_class == "hybrid"),
    FN = sum(predicted_class == "pure" & true_class == "hybrid"),
    FP = sum(predicted_class == "hybrid" & true_class == "pure"),
    TN = sum(predicted_class == "pure" & true_class == "pure"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Overall_Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN),
    Accuracy = if_else((TP + FP) > 0, TP / (TP + FP), 0),
    Efficiency = if_else((TP + FN) > 0, TP / (TP + FN), 0)
  )

# View the result summary table
summary_data <- multi_class_matrices %>% group_by(hybrid_status, threshold) %>% summarize(Overall_Accuracy, Accuracy, Efficiency, .groups="drop")

potential_thresholds <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Efficiency == 1) %>%
  group_by(hybrid_status) %>%
  filter(threshold == min(threshold, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Plotting threshold acc, eff, pref

```{r}
# 4. Plot Threshold vs Overall_Accuracy, faceted by each hybrid class
accuracy_plot <- ggplot(multi_class_matrices, aes(x = threshold, y = Accuracy, color = hybrid_status, linetype = hybrid_status)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(Overall_Accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(bottom_threshold, top_threshold, by = 0.02)) +
  labs(
    #itle = "Identification Threshold vs. Overall_Accuracy by Hybrid Class",
    # subtitle = "Comparing performance curves across all hybrid populations on a single plot",
    x = "Identification Threshold",
    y = "Accuracy",
    color = "Hybrid Class",
    linetype = "Hybrid Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
accuracy_plot

efficiency_plot <- ggplot(multi_class_matrices, aes(x = threshold, y = Efficiency, color = hybrid_status, linetype = hybrid_status)) +
```

# including threshold lines
```{r}
potential_thresholds <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Efficiency == 1) %>%
  group_by(hybrid_status) %>%
  filter(threshold == min(threshold, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(min_threshold = threshold)

# Rename the hybrid classes with their thresholds 
multi_class_matrices_intermediate <- multi_class_matrices %>%
  left_join(
    potential_thresholds %>%
      select(hybrid_status, min_threshold),
    by = "hybrid_status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = paste0(
      hybrid_status, " (", round(min_threshold, 3), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-min_threshold)

# Rename the hybrids with their thresholds 
potential_thresholds <- potential_thresholds %>% mutate(
    hybrid_status = paste0(hybrid_status, " (", round(min_threshold, 3), ")")
  ) 

# SELECT HYBRIDS and THRESHOLDS WE WANT TO INCLUDE
multi_class_matrices_intermediate <- multi_class_matrices_intermediate %>% filter(str_detect(hybrid_status, "BC1HYB"))
potential_thresholds <- potential_thresholds %>% filter(str_detect(hybrid_status, "BC1HYB"))

plot <- ggplot(
  multi_class_matrices_intermediate,
  aes(x = threshold, y = Efficiency, color = hybrid_status, linetype = hybrid_status)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  # Vertical line for the minimum threshold of each hybrid class
```
